simple.summary: אֲשַׂרְאֵלָה (ʼĂsarʼêlâh) means Asarelah , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 25 2.

definitions.full: H841. Asarelah אֲשַׂרְאֵ֫לָה proper name, masculine a son of Asaph 1Chr 25:2 compare יְשַׂרְאֵ֫לָה 25:14 .
